notes: Microsoft Store identity, reserved in Partner Center on 13 Nov 2026 (issue #1157, Product identity page). Name, publisher and publisher display name must stay exactly as Partner Center states them, or the Store rejects the upload.

The Store signs the package after certification, so the Store bundle is uploaded unsigned and needs no windows-signing certificate. It is a different package family from the sideloaded beta and developer packages; all three share the %LOCALAPPDATA%\JustSpeakToIt data directory.
The display name must equal the reserved Store name "Just Speak to It".
runFullTrust and unvirtualizedResources are restricted capabilities: each submission must justify them in Partner Center (Docs/windows-installer.md, Microsoft Store package).
The version comes from the Stable candidate manifest's 12-digit build (windows_installer.package_version); its fourth part is 0, as the Store requires.

The execution aliases are the beta's: install the Store app or the sideloaded beta, not both. Settings in the developer notes about write virtualisation, the startup task, maxVersionTested and processor architectures apply unchanged.

presentation.description: Dictate into any Windows app with Just Speak to It.
